language.title: Language
preview.asDesigned: {family} as designed. Move a slider on the right, or pick another font.
preview.noStretch: Fontbend couldn't stretch {family}, so values past its own range show at the range's end.
preview.loadFailed: {family} didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
summary.same: Same width and strokes as the original.
adjust.title: Adjust
slider.pastBreaks: {where}, past the font's own range, some letters break
download.title: Download
download.filesHint: Install the TTF on your computer. Use the WOFF2 on websites.
download.oflText: You can use and change this font in any project, logos and games included. Keep the copyright lines in the font, and don't sell the font file on its own.
download.reservedText: This font reserves its name, so the font you make needs a name of its own.
download.unknownText: Fontbend can't tell which license this font has. Use the font you make only as that license allows.
download.signature: Fontbend writes “Made with Fontbend” into the font's description field.
download.noMemory: Not enough memory in this tab. Download only the TTF, or close other tabs and try again.
download.woff2Retry: Download only the TTF, or try again.
build.fontFailed: {family} didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
build.builderFailed: The font builder didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
build.licenseFailed: The license file didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
build.stretchFailed: Fontbend couldn't stretch this font past its own range. Bring the values back inside it to download.
build.stopped: The font builder stopped. Try again.
build.other: Something in this font stopped Fontbend from making the file. Try again, or try other values.
check.title: Character check
check.subtitle: Characters: {subset}
check.noCmap: {file} has no character map, so its letters can't be checked.
check.note: Text in these languages will show in another font.
check.turkishFix: In Turkish text, f and i no longer join, so the i keeps its dot.
share.label: Shared link
share.kept: Your changed fonts are still in Recent.
share.older: This link is from an older version of Fontbend
share.gone.one: {axes} is no longer in {family}. Everything else opened as shared.
share.gone.other: {axes} are no longer in {family}. Everything else opened as shared.
share.damagedBody: The original {family} opened instead. Ask the sender for the link again.
share.newer: This link is from a newer version of Fontbend
share.newerBody: Reload the page, then open the link again. The original {family} opened for now.
share.noFile: This link is for a font file that isn't open here
share.noFileBody: Open the same file in Open, then this link again. The original {family} opened for now.
recent.chooseAgain: Choose {file} again to keep working on it.
recent.offBody: This browser doesn't let Fontbend keep anything, for example in a private window. The Copy link button still saves your settings in the link.
recent.emptyBody: Fonts you change are listed here. Font files you open aren't copied, so choose them again to continue.
recent.note: Recent fonts are kept in this browser's storage. Clearing the site's data removes them.
open.formats: TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2, up to {size}.
open.orDrop: Or drop the file on the canvas.
open.allowedOnly: Open only fonts you're allowed to change, like those from Google Fonts. The file stays on your computer.
open.question: Can you change this font?
open.questionBody: {file} doesn't say which license it has. Continue only if you're allowed to change it.
open.tooBigBody: Fontbend opens fonts up to {max}. Most font sites also offer a smaller, Latin-only file.
open.brokenBody: It isn't a font file, or it's damaged. If it is a font, download it again.
open.noAxesBody: Fontbend changes variable fonts, whose weight or width can move. Their files often have “Variable” or “[wght]” in the name.
open.outlinesBody: Fontbend changes fonts with TrueType outlines. The same font is often offered as a TTF too.
